configurations.name: backend
runtimeArgs: $env:JAVA_HOME = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.jdks/openjdk-27.0.1.0.3'; $env:DATABASE_URL = 'jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5544/followup'; $env:MEETINGS_AUTOMATION_ENABLED = 'true'; if (Test-Path 'secrets/backend.env') { Get-Content 'secrets/backend.env' | Where-Object { $_ -match '^[A-Z_]+=.+' } | ForEach-Object { $kv = $_ -split '=', 2; Set-Item -Path ('env:' + $kv[0]) -Value $kv[1].Trim() } }; Set-Location backend; ./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
